literal_meaning: একা বা দুজন (alone or in a pair)
figurative_meaning_en: Sometimes one person, sometimes two people
example_sentences_in_bangla: একলা-দোকলা যাওয়া যায় না, অন্তত তিনজন হলে ভালো।
জীবনে একলা-দোকলা চলবে না, বন্ধুবান্ধবের সাহায্য নিতে হবে।
example_sentences_in_english: You can't travel alone or just in two; at least three would be better.
In life, you can't make it alone or just with one other; you need friends' support.
note: The idiom implies that certain activities or journeys require more than one or two people, reflecting communal aspects of Bengali social life.
